cohort: Six hundred and ten women diagnosed with pre-eclampsia between January 2002 and December 2022, who conceived either naturally or through IVF.
finding: Contrary to expectations, naturally conceived pregnancies exhibited more severe pre-eclampsia phenotypes compared to IVF pregnancies, while neonatal echocardiography findings were similar between conception methods but associated with gestational age at delivery and pregestational diabetes mellitus.
